paite: Huan Ahaziah nu Athaliah in atapa asi chih atheih in, athou a, kumpipa tapa tengteng athat vek hi.
heading: Judah Kumpinu Athaliah / (2 Kro 22.10-23.15)
english: Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal offspring.

paite: Ahaziah tapa Joash bel kumpipa Jehoram tanu, Ahaziah sanggamnu Jehosheba in kumpipa tapa athahte uh lak a pan pimang in, adontu toh lupna dantan ah a-omsak a; Athaliah muh theih louh ding in asel ua, huchi in thah ahita kei hi.
english: But Jehosheba, the daughter of King Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him away from among the king’s sons who were slain, even him and his nurse, and put them in the bedroom; and they hid him from Athaliah, so that he was not slain.

paite: Amah bel amah toh TOUPA' inn ah kum guk akibu ua, huchi in Athaliah in huai gam ah vai ahawmta hi.
english: He was with her hidden in Yahweh’s house six years while Athaliah reigned over the land.

paite: Akum sagihna ah Jehoiada in Keroth mite leh galvil sepaihte lak a mi sepaih za heutute asamsak a, TOUPA' inn ah akiang ah apilutsak hi. Akiang uah thu akhung a, TOUPA' inn ah akichiamsak a, kumpipa tapa amusak hi.
english: In the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the captains over hundreds of the Carites and of the guard, and brought them to him into Yahweh’s house; and he made a covenant with them, and made a covenant with them in Yahweh’s house, and showed them the king’s son.

paite: Ama'n, “Na hih ding uh hichibang ahi. Na lak ua Sabbath ni a hong dingte seh thum suah seh khat in kumpipa' inn na veng ding uh.
english: He commanded them, saying, “This is what you must do: a third of you, who come in on the Sabbath, shall be keepers of the watch of the king’s house;

paite: Seh thum suah seh khat bel Sur kulh kongpi ah na om ding uh. Huchibang in na veng ding ua, asiat ding na dal ding uhi.
english: a third of you shall be at the gate Sur; and a third of you at the gate behind the guard. So you shall keep the watch of the house, and be a barrier.

paite: Na lak ua pawl nih, Sabbath ni a pai dingte'n kumpipa kiang ah TOUPA' inn na veng ding uhi.
english: The two companies of you, even all who go out on the Sabbath, shall keep the watch of Yahweh’s house around the king.

paite: Michih in galvan tawi in kumpipa na umsuak ding ua; kuapeuh huai huamsung a hong lut na thah zel ding uh ahi. Huchi in kumpipa alut leh apawt zui vialvial un," chi in thu apia hi.
english: You shall surround the king, every man with his weapons in his hand; and he who comes within the ranks, let him be slain. Be with the king when he goes out, and when he comes in.”

paite: Sepaih za heutute'n siampu Jehoiada thupiak bangbang in ahih ua; amau heutu chiat Sabbath ni a hong dingte leh Sabbath ni a pai dingte api ua, siampu Jehoiada kiang ah ahoh uhi.
english: The captains over hundreds did according to all that Jehoiada the priest commanded; and they each took his men, those who were to come in on the Sabbath with those who were to go out on the Sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.

paite: Siampu in sepaih za heutute TOUPA' inn a om, kumpipa David teipite leh lumte apia hi.
english: The priest delivered to the captains over hundreds the spears and shields that had been King David’s, which were in Yahweh’s house.

paite: Galvil sepaihte'n galvan tawi chiat in, Tempul sik taklam a kipan veilam tan in maitam leh inn zul ah kumpipa a ding in umkhum uhi.
english: The guard stood, every man with his weapons in his hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, along by the altar and the house, around the king.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa tapa ahon pikhia a, lallukhu akhusak hi. Theihsakna thu apia a; kumpipa in abawl ua, sathau anilh ua; akhut uh abeng ua, "Pathian in kumpipa hondam hen,” achi uhi.
english: Then he brought out the king’s son, and put the crown on him, and gave him the covenant; and they made him king and anointed him; and they clapped their hands, and said, “Long live the king!”

paite: Galvilmi leh mipite husa Athaliah in ana zak in, TOUPA' inn ah mipite lak ah ava hoh hi.
english: When Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people, she came to the people into Yahweh’s house;

paite: A-en a, ngai in, kumpipa dan dungzui in khuam zul ah ana dingh a, sepaih heutute leh pengkul mut mite bel kumpipa kiangnai ah adingh uhi. Huai gam mite'n nuam asa mahmah ua, pengkul amut uh. Huchi in Athaliah in apuante abotkek a, "Guksawmna! Guksawmna ahita ve!" chi in akikou hi.
english: and she looked, and behold, the king stood by the pillar, as the tradition was, with the captains and the trumpets by the king; and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew trumpets. Then Athaliah tore her clothes and cried, “Treason! Treason!”

paite: Siampu Jehoiada in sepaihte tung a heutute dia aseh sepaih za heutute thu apia a, akiang uah, "Sepaihte kikal ah pawtsak in. Kuapeuh amah zui namsau a satlup ding ahi," achi hi. Siampu in, "TOUPA' inn a thah ding ahi kei," ana chita ngal a.
english: Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of hundreds who were set over the army, and said to them, “Bring her out between the ranks. Kill anyone who follows her with the sword.” For the priest said, “Don’t let her be slain in Yahweh’s house.”

paite: Huchi in aman ua; kumpipa' inn a sakolte lutna lampi a pai in, huai ah athatta uh.
english: So they seized her; and she went by the way of the horses’ entry to the king’s house, and she was slain there.

paite: Jehoiada in TOUPA leh kumpipa leh mipite kikal leh kumpipa leh mipite kikal ah TOUPA mite ahihna ding un thukhun abawl hi.
heading: Jehoiada Puahthaknate / (2 Kro 23.16-21)
english: Jehoiada made a covenant between Yahweh and the king and the people, that they should be Yahweh’s people; also between the king and the people.

paite: Huai gammi tengteng Baal inn ah ahoh ua, ahihchim ua; amaitamte leh alimte ahihnen dimdem ua, Baal siampu Mattan leng maitam bul ah athat uh. Huchi in siampu in TOUPA' inn vengmi heutute asepta hi.
english: All the people of the land went to the house of Baal, and broke it down. They broke his altars and his images in pieces thoroughly, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. The priest appointed officers over Yahweh’s house.

paite: Ama'n sepaih za heutute, veng mite, galvil sepaihte leh huai gam a mi tengteng api a, TOUPA' inn a pan kumpipa apikhia ua, galvil mite kongpi tawn in kumpipa' inn a lut in, kumpipa laltutphah ah atuta hi.
english: He took the captains over hundreds, and the Carites, and the guard, and all the people of the land; and they brought down the king from Yahweh’s house, and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king’s house. He sat on the throne of the kings.

paite: Huchi in huai gam a mi tengteng akipak ua, khopi buai lou in a-omta hi; Athaliah namsau in kumpipa' inn ah athat uhi.
english: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. They had slain Athaliah with the sword at the king’s house.

paite: Joash in vai ahawm pat lai in kum sagih a upa ahi.
english: Jehoash was seven years old when he began to reign.
